segments.sn26.2:1.2: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, rūpānaṃ uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segments.sn26.2:1.3: Yo saddānaṃ … yo gandhānaṃ … yo rasānaṃ … yo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ … yo dhammānaṃ uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segments.sn26.2:1.8: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo.
segments.sn26.2:1.9: Yo saddānaṃ … yo gandhānaṃ … yo rasānaṃ … yo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ … yo dhammānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
